I think I'm sick with a cold.
note: 'Catch a cold' = bị cảm.

vi: Mình muốn đặt lịch khám với bác sĩ.
en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor.
alt: I'd like to book an appointment with the doctor.
I want to make an appointment with a doctor.
I'd like to schedule an appointment with the doctor.

vi: Bạn nên uống thuốc sau khi ăn.
en: You should take the medicine after eating.
alt: You should take the medicine after meals.
You should take this medicine after you eat.
You should take the medication after eating.

vi: Mình đang nấu cơm tối.
en: I'm cooking dinner.
alt: I'm making dinner.
I'm preparing dinner.
I'm cooking supper.

vi: Bạn nhớ tắt đèn trước khi ra ngoài nhé.
en: Remember to turn off the lights before you go out.
alt: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave.
Remember to switch off the lights before you leave.
Please turn off the lights before you go out.
note: 'Remember to + V' = nhớ làm gì (việc sắp làm).

vi: Mình quên mang chìa khóa nên bị khóa ngoài nhà.
en: I forgot my keys, so I got locked out.
alt: I forgot my keys and got locked out.
I forgot to bring my keys, so I'm locked out of the house.
I forgot my key, so I locked myself out.
note: 'Locked out' = bị khóa ngoài.

vi: Điện thoại của mình sắp hết pin rồi.
en: My phone is about to die.
alt: My phone is almost out of battery.
My phone battery is almost dead.
My phone is running out of battery.
My phone's battery is about to run out.
note: 'About to die' là cách nói tự nhiên về pin sắp hết.

vi: Bạn có sạc điện thoại cho mình mượn được không?
en: Could I borrow your phone charger?
alt: Can I borrow your charger?
Do you have a charger I could borrow?
Could I borrow your charger, please?
Can I borrow your phone charger?

vi: Mình đang cố giảm cân.
en: I'm trying to lose weight.
alt: I'm trying to lose some weight.
I'm on a diet.
I'm trying to slim down.

vi: Cuối tuần mình thường đi dạo công viên.
en: I usually go for a walk in the park on weekends.
alt: On weekends I usually walk in the park.
I usually take a walk in the park on the weekend.
I usually go walking in the park on weekends.

vi: Mình bị kẹt trong thang máy, bạn gọi giúp mình nhé.
en: I'm stuck in the elevator. Could you call for help?
alt: I'm trapped in the elevator. Please call for help.
I'm stuck in the lift. Could you call someone for help?
I'm stuck in the elevator, can you get help?

vi: Mình cần giặt đồ vào cuối tuần.
en: I need to do laundry this weekend.
alt: I need to do the laundry on the weekend.
I have to do laundry this weekend.
I need to wash my clothes this weekend.
note: 'Do laundry' = giặt đồ.

vi: Mình vừa chuyển đến đây nên chưa quen đường lắm.
en: I just moved here, so I don't know my way around yet.
alt: I just moved here, so I'm not familiar with the area yet.
I've just moved here, so I don't know the area well yet.
I just moved here and I'm still learning my way around.
note: 'Know my way around' = quen đường.

vi: Bạn có thể mở cửa sổ giúp mình không?
en: Could you open the window, please?
alt: Can you open the window, please?
Could you please open the window?
Would you mind opening the window?

vi: Dạo này mình ngủ không ngon nên cảm thấy mệt mỏi cả ngày.
en: I haven't been sleeping well lately, so I feel tired all day.
alt: I haven't been sleeping well recently, so I'm tired all day.
I've been sleeping badly lately, so I feel exhausted all day.
I haven't slept well lately, so I feel tired all day.
